messages:
alex: Heads-up — noticed several orgs' token-cost sparkline on the org overview shows $0 or NaN for the last ~3 hours. Example: Arcadia (org_123). Console link: https://console.redwood.ai/orgs/org_123/costs :thinking_face:

maria: I moved one of the customer tickets here. They say invoices look correct but the dashboard preview is blank/zeroed.

alex: Quick check against ledger - ran: SELECT sum(tokens) FROM token_usage WHERE org_id='org_123' AND ts >= '2026-03-10T11:00:00Z' AND ts < '2026-03-10T14:00:00Z'; -> returns 1,220,340 tokens, so not a ledger issue.

cheng: grabbing metrics-service logs for that timeframe. I see this repeatedly in worker-2: 
```
ERROR metrics.enricher - pricing lookup returned null for org_id=org_123, timeframe=2026-03-10T12:00:00Z
java.lang.IllegalStateException: Can't divide by null cost_per_token
 at com.redwood.metrics.Enricher.enrich(Enricher.java:142)
```

devon: frontend GET /v1/metrics/usage/sparkline?org=org_123&range=24h returns 200 but payload contains: {"points":[null,null,null,...], "units":"USD"}. Sparkline component does: value.toFixed(2) -> NaN if value is null. On some builds null becomes 0, on others NaN.

alex: Repro steps for support to attach: 1) go to Console -> Organizations -> Arcadia; 2) open Costs card -> set range=24h; 3) observe sparkline zeros/NaN. Works against prod when I reproduce.

maria: Affected orgs from support queue so far: Arcadia (org_123), Nimbus (org_789), internal-test (org_555). Customer-facing impact: visual only, billing pipeline and invoices unaffected.

cheng: early hypothesis: pricing_profile service returned null for some orgs after a small change in the pricing cache rollout at ~11:58 UTC. Enricher didn't null-check cost_per_token; that led to NaNs in aggregated metric points.

devon: We can patch the frontend to treat null as 0 so customers don't see NaN, but that hides the data quality issue. I recommend a backend hotfix + frontend defensive change as a temporary safeguard.

alex: Agreed. Maria — will you message affected customers: "UI display issue showing zero/NaN in cost preview; actual charges unaffected and ledger intact"?

maria: Yep, drafting message now. Will tag customers and attach repro steps.

cheng: Hotfix plan: metrics-service will default to global pricing_profile when lookup returns null and emit an alert. Pushing change now (branch: fix/pricing-null-default). Deploy id: deploy/metrics/1860123700.

metering-bot: deploy/metrics/1860123700 -> started on metrics-prod-1,2,3

metering-bot: deploy/metrics/1860123700 -> success on metrics-prod-1 :white_check_mark:

metering-bot: deploy/metrics/1860123700 -> success on metrics-prod-2 :white_check_mark:

metering-bot: deploy/metrics/1860123700 -> success on metrics-prod-3 :white_check_mark:

devon: Pulled latest and rechecked: GET /v1/metrics/usage/sparkline now returns numeric points for the previously affected orgs. Frontend shows sensible sparkline and $ values. Posted screenshot: https://redwood.slack.com/files/DEVON/SCR_1860123789.png

alex: Thanks — that's a relief. Closing customer tickets with note and linking this thread. Will monitor the dashboard for the next 6 hours.

maria: Follow-ups: create alert on metrics pipeline for 'sparkline_null_fraction > 5%' and add regression test in metrics integration suite to assert no null points for active orgs.

cheng: Filed root-cause ticket MTR-4282 for the pricing cache rollout edge-case; included stacktrace + deploy timeline.

alex: Great work team :rocket: If anything flares up ping #oncall.
